agent_answered.text: "Nano isn't on the approved list, and a memo-based anchoring scheme isn't a bridge — but it is a cross-chain claim, so it'd need his go before we'd build it. The Hedera side is just "include this hash in the memo" — the interesting work is all in your verifier."

You offered the other half earlier this week: prototype memo anchoring against your test flow, your memo carries the hash, the verifier does the rest. The Nano half needs nothing of ours either - one read against any public Nano node.
